title: Little Havana Cultural and Tasting Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Local for over +20 years, been giving this going on 4 years. I've tasted many pastries and formed friendships with lots of Cuban locals. I will show you the best spots and introduce you to local celebrities like Miss Guillermina, the Grandmother of Little Havana. Get ready for a memorable and personal experience!

Little Havana is a hidden gem and I will show you! SO MUCH to see in the Historical neighborhood! Cuban cigars in Miami? There’s a way around the embargo! We will start with an organic juice tasting. Enjoy gourmet treats from an authentic Cuban bakery, included in your tour is a Ham-filled Croquette, Guava-filled Puff pastry & a Cuban Soda. Taste the famous Cuban coffee, colada, in a hidden gem café. In our tour, we will be passing by iconic sites like the Famous Ball & Chain. Artist like Chet Baker, Count Basie and even Billy Holiday made debuts! Also, Domino Park and Tower Theatre will be in our route! Admire classical cars used as main transportation in Cuba still today.
